verdict.rationale: Otter has an AI Chat assistant that could plausibly act as an MCP client, so this axis applies. The evidence only shows Otter running its own MCP server that exposes meeting data to Claude and ChatGPT, which is the opposite role. Its built-in CRM and document connectors for AI Chat are a related feature, not the ability to plug in arbitrary MCP servers, so there is no evidence Otter can consume external MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
